title: Q13
description:
“You, Lord, in the beginning laid the foundation of the earth.”
Read: Psa 102 (whole psalm, especially vv. 12–22, 25–27)
a) In Psa 102 an afflicted man prays to Yahweh, who will arise and have mercy on Zion, and to whom nations and kings will come. Hebrews applies the Creator lines to the Son. What does that wider psalm bring forward about who the Son is and what He will do for Zion?
